name: Berry White Jeeter All In One Diamonds Vape | Pocket Ready | 1g | Indica
description:
Berry White is an indica strain that brings together berry flavors like blueberry and strawberry, with a dash of citrus vibes and a touch of earthiness. The high it gives you is chill yet keeps you alert, making it awesome for a mid-day breather. Imagine putting on some Barry White tunes and sparking up a Berry White Jeeter – it's like a cheat code for good vibes, man!

Ultra clean. Ultra potent. Ultra smooth. Built for our most refined extract, this AIO is made for Liquid Diamonds. With lighter viscosity and higher potency, the hardware is engineered to preserve clarity and deliver smooth, powerful hits without clogging or flooding.
